name: Further Concerns
summary: East of Goldshire, Marshal Dughan sends you to check reports of danger. You cross Elwynn Forest to speak with Guard Thomas at the river crossing toward Redridge.

sections.title: Eyes on the Eastern Crossing
sections.body: Marshal Dughan commands Goldshire's garrison and takes reports of hostile creatures along Elwynn's riverbanks seriously. Bandits and vermin already trouble the forest's center, so he cannot spare guards from town. He sends you east to consult Guard Thomas, the sentry at the bridge toward Redridge.

sections.title: A Frontier Stretched Thin
sections.body: Guard Thomas has held the bridge outpost for more than a week and has seen the danger for himself. Hostile, semi-intelligent murlocs have made camps along eastern Elwynn's waterways. Stormwind's army is absent, and local garrisons guard town walls and supply lines. Rural bridge posts like Thomas's are left isolated as the danger grows.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Dughan send me to Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan sends you to Guard Thomas because reports speak of murlocs creeping into the eastern waterways. Thomas has been stationed at the eastern Elwynn bridge for a week, so Dughan trusts him to confirm the threat.
Guard Thomas watches the wooden bridge over the river in far eastern Elwynn Forest, on the road toward the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: What threat does Guard Thomas confirm?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas confirms that hostile, semi-intelligent murlocs have settled along eastern Elwynn's streams and waterways. They threaten travelers and nearby farmsteads.

faq.q: How do you reach Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: Take the road east from Goldshire across Elwynn Forest to the bridge over the eastern river, where Guard Thomas keeps watch.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind send an army to help eastern Elwynn?
faq.answer: Stormwind's forces are stretched thin with King Varian Wrynn missing and resources diverted from the countryside. Sentries such as Guard Thomas are left to rely largely on passing adventurers.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: After confirming the murloc presence, Guard Thomas asks you to investigate what became of the other sentries who patrolled the riverbank and failed to return.

angles.text: For the Alliance, thin defenses near the capital reveal growing cracks in the Kingdom of Stormwind's strength.
As a human of Elwynn, you face murlocs whose spread threatens the breadbasket farms and trade routes connecting Goldshire to Lakeshire.
